abstention_patterns: \b(?:cannot|can t|can not|unable to|not able to) (?:answer|determine|tell|say|know|find|recall|be determined)\b
config.all_8_regret: max u over 4-subsets minus u(all 8); negative when the full pool is right and no 4-subset is

bootstrap.unit: question (one table per question per arm)

config.calls: reader calls per question, the answering call included: 1 for each zero-search baseline, m for a search (it answers with the chosen subset's reply), m + 1 for agree_full (the full pool)
config.confidence: math.fsum of the float32 sampled-token log-probs of every recorded generated token (end-of-turn included when generated); mean = sum / tokens
config.oracle_search: AM1b's direct search on the judged utility (needs labels; exact expectation), a reference only
config.regret: max u over 4-subsets minus u(chosen) (AM1b's convention; for a 4-subset equal to harness.memcredit.keep_set_regret_range on its indicator)

seeds.rng: random.Random(f'{seed}:{question_id}:{arm}:am1d-search').sample(the 70 4-subsets, 70); the first m are read; shared by every utility

config.tie_break: lower BM25 rank sum, then lexicographically smaller sorted BM25 ranks

data: development split only (63 questions x 2 arms); no confirmatory data opened

pass.name: job 1441, rd-eager-gpu0 (GPU 0, canonical order, eager mode, first 16 questions); labels: job 1441 judge32-gpu0 (Qwen3-32B, eager)
job 1411, reader-gpu0 (GPU 0, canonical order, compiled batch-invariant mode); labels: job 1411 judge32-gpu0 (Qwen3-32B)

posthoc.note: added after the first AM1d results were seen; not a declared utility; not used to pick the best label-free rule

nonabstain.describe: 1 unless reply(S) matches the abstention list

nonabstain_vote.describe: non-abstention, then the vote count, then mean log-prob

vote.describe: count of queried subsets with the same normalized reply, then mean log-prob
